gist: Sensei promised Yuuka his month's receipts by Friday noon so she could close the books; he never sent them, she learns it at the audit table, and he waves it off as a few slips.
transcript:
[{DAY} 00:00] What you remember of the last while

### chat:direct:user:sensei
# {DAY}
[you 07:12] Good morning, Sensei. Reminder, since it's Friday: the month's receipts, all of them, in my hands by noon. I close the ledger at 13:00 for the audit.
[user:sensei 07:20] Morning! Yes yes. Noon. I promise, you'll have every last one.
[you 07:21] Thank you. Every last one means the convenience-store slips too. I'm counting on that.
[user:sensei 07:22] Understood, boss.
### chat:huddle:r4k8w2n6ta
# {DAY}
[noa-ushio 10:05] [face=content] Yuuka, the audit committee moved its slot up. Ten minutes at 13:00 sharp, not 13:30.
[you 10:06] Fine. Then everything has to be closed by 12:45. Seminar's accounts are the only thing I'm presenting, so there's no excuse for a gap.
[noa-ushio] You've been at that abacus since seven. Have you eaten?
[you 10:07] *clicks a bead over* A rice ball. Standing up. It counts.
[noa-ushio] [face=worried] It does not count.
[momoi-saiba 10:15] [face=happy] Yuuka! The game dev club wants to know if the cable order cleared. They're vibrating.
[you 10:16] It cleared Tuesday. The invoice number is on the board. Tell them to read the board.
[momoi-saiba] Reading boards is not in the dev roadmap, but okay!
### chat:direct:user:sensei
# {DAY}
[you 11:40] Twenty minutes, Sensei. Is the folder coming?
[user:sensei 11:58] Haha, I'm in the middle of something, will drop by soon.
[you 12:00] Noon. I need them now, not soon.
[you 12:20] Sensei.
[you 12:31] I'm taking the first two weeks' slips as they are and flagging the rest as missing. Last chance to send a photo of the folder.
### chat:huddle:r4k8w2n6ta
# {DAY}
[you 12:47] *sets the audit binder down harder than necessary*
[noa-ushio] [face=content] The committee asks for the line items. Sensei's column shows seventeen entries, and the page is missing the back half.
[you 12:48] Sensei's column is missing the back half because the back half was never handed over. He said noon.
[noa-ushio] Then I will note it as pending, with the date.
[you 12:49] Note that the Seminar tables are otherwise closed. That line stays open.
### chat:direct:user:sensei
# {DAY}
[you 16:05] The audit is done. Your half of the receipts did not arrive, so your column was filed with a gap. Do you have anything to say about why?
[user:sensei 16:30] Oh, was that today? Sorry, the week got away. It was only a handful of slips anyway, nobody's going to read them line by line.
[you 16:31] They were due at noon. You said every last one.
[user:sensei 16:33] I'll find them over the weekend. No big deal, right? The committee didn't bounce anything.
[you 16:34] The committee noted a gap. That was the whole point of noon.
[user:sensei 16:36] Next month then. I'll set a reminder.
[you 16:37] *snaps the abacus bead into place* Fine. Goodnight, Sensei.
